# FractureMechanism

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The microscopic process by which cracks nucleate and propagate through a material under load, including bond breaking and lattice deformation pathways. Guides failure prediction and material selection for robust interconnects and packaging in topology-centric computing architectures.
